records.name: EIC Accelerator
records.institution: European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA); investment component via the EIC Fund

amount.label: Grant component below €2.5M (TRL 6-8); investment (equity) component €1M-€10M (TRL 6-9); higher amounts via STEP Scale Up

budget.label: 2026 indicative: €414M Accelerator Open + €220M Accelerator Challenges (WP2026). 2027: €428M Open + €150M Challenges = €578M (WP2027, adopted 5 Nov 2026)

eligibility: SMEs established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe associated country
Small mid-caps (up to 499 employees) in a Member State or associated country: investment-only support (blended finance only in exceptional cases for rapid scale-up)

Natural persons or legal entities intending to establish an SME/small mid-cap in a Member State or associated country, or to invest in one; non-associated third-country applicants may apply if they will establish or relocate the SME to a Member State/associated country
Short proposals can be submitted at any time; full proposals are batched at cut-off dates (5pm Brussels time)
Since 17 June 2026 the EIC also invests in defence and dual-use technologies

records.name: EIC Transition
records.institution: European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA)

amount.label: Grants up to €2.5M; booster grants up to €50,000

eligibility: Single legal entities (start-ups, SMEs or research performing organisations) established in a Member State or associated country; affiliated entities and subcontracting allowed
Larger companies (non-SMEs) are not eligible as single applicants

Proposal must build on results of an eligible project: EIC Pathfinder (incl. H2020 EIC pilot Pathfinder, FET-Open, FET-Proactive, FET Flagships), Horizon Europe ERC Proof of Concept, H2020 Societal Challenges / Horizon Europe Pillar II RIAs, European Defence Fund actions, or Horizon Europe Research Infrastructures RIAs
Technology maturation starting from completed TRL 3 with the aim of reaching TRL 5 or beyond

records.name: EIC Pathfinder (Open and Challenges)
records.institution: European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA)

amount.label: Grants up to €4M (or more if duly justified); booster grants up to €50,000

budget.label: 2026 indicative: €166M Pathfinder Open + €96M Pathfinder Challenges (WP2026). 2027: €166M Open + €82M Challenges = €248M (WP2027)

eligibility: Standard: consortia of at least three independent legal entities established in different countries; at least one in an EU Member State and at least two others in different Member States or associated countries
Pathfinder Challenges only: single applicants and two-partner consortia also allowed

records.name: EIC STEP Scale Up
records.institution: European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA); investments by the EIC Fund

amount.label: Equity-only investment of €10M-€30M (EIC Fund) in rounds of €50M-€150M

budget.label: 2026 budget €300M (plus separate STEP Scale Up Defence €100M); 2027: €290M (plus STEP Scale Up Defence €100M)

records.countries: EU27 + eligible Horizon Europe associated countries (excluding the UK)
eligibility: A single SME or small mid-cap (fewer than 500 employees) established in an EU Member State or eligible associated country (excluding the UK)
Investors may submit on behalf of an eligible company
Pre-commitment from a single qualified investor covering at least 20% of a total target funding round of €50M-€150M
Technology areas: digital and deep tech, clean technologies, biotechnologies (quantum and semiconductors named as priorities)
Applications accepted any time; evaluated in batches at cut-off dates

records.name: InvestEU Equity products (EIF)
records.institution: European Investment Fund (EIF), under the InvestEU Fund EU guarantee

budget.label: InvestEU Fund EU budgetary guarantee of €26.2bn (all InvestEU, not equity only); EIF deploys close to €35bn combining >€18bn InvestEU resources with own resources

records.countries: EU27 (plus Overseas Countries and Territories and other participating countries per call documents)
eligibility: Applicants are financial intermediaries / fund managers (venture capital incl. business angels, private equity, private credit, incl. fund-of-funds and cross-over funds); startups do not apply directly

Funds must target one or more thematic strategies (Capital Markets Union, enabling sectors, climate and environmental solutions, digital and cultural & creative sectors, social impact) and/or horizontal priorities
Funds must be based in and invest in EU Member States, OCTs or other participating countries as set in the call documents
Selection via call for expression of interest, first come first served, followed by due diligence

deadlines.label: Deadline for applications to the InvestEU equity call for expression of interest (ongoing selection)

records.name: European Tech Champions Initiative (ETCI 2.0)
records.institution: EIB Group / European Investment Fund (EIF), with EU Member States and private institutional investors

amount.label: Fund-of-funds commitments to mega funds (€1bn+) and, for the first time, mid-sized growth funds (€300m+); average ticket of €200M per company at mega-fund level

budget.label: First closing with around €2bn in commitments (9 Nov 2026); fundraising target up to €15bn; EIB Group up to €1.25bn own funds; aims to mobilise up to €80bn. ETCI 1 (2023): up to €3.9bn

eligibility: Applicants are growth-stage VC/PE fund managers; ETCI 1 required a target fund size of at least €1bn; ETCI 2.0 also open to mid-sized funds (€300m+)
Fund managers submit proposals via the EIF standard investment proposal form
ETCI 2.0 investor side open to private institutional investors (pension funds, insurers, foundations, family offices, banks, national promotional institutions)
Strategy focus: AI, deep tech, life sciences, cybersecurity, space, fintech and clean tech
